title: Clauses + burn: daily scratch and quick to-dos
content:
Quick context: running month-end checks + a few contract redlines on my plate. Not formal — this is my running list for today & handoff notes for Mira if I get pulled into the all-hands.

PRIORITIES (today)
- [ ] Reconcile disputed invoice INV-2026-0117 (ACME Cloud) — amount showing $14,320.00 vs AP record $13,920. Need vendor breakdown (hosting vs. services). Follow-up: email AP + vendor by 11:00.
- [ ] Finish redline for Partner A (SaaS reseller) — focus: termination fee cap, data-subprocessing clause, and indemnity scope. Goal: send to Mira for legal review by EOD.
- [ ] Confirm renewal notice date for CloudBackup (contract CB-0043) — auto-renews 2026-04-01. Need to decide notify-by date: 2026-03-10 already missed, escalate to Samir to see if we can negotiate a 30-day opt-out.

INVOICE NOTES / QUICK LINES
- INV-2026-0117 (ACME Cloud) — line items: monthly infra $9,800, one-time setup $4,200, credits applied -$1,680. Discrepancy: AP system removed credits; ask AP to reapply.
- INV-2026-0122 (Consulting — Freelance) — flagged for services classification (1099 vs contractor). Confirm with HR/payroll before payment.
- Payment window reminders: prioritize anything > $10k for exec sign-off.

CONTRACT REDLINE SKETCH (Partner A)
- Section 4.1 (Termination for convenience): propose 60 days instead of 90; add cap: termination liability limited to 3 months of average monthly fees.
- Section 6.2 (Indemnity): narrow to claims arising from gross negligence or willful misconduct; remove broad third-party IP indemnities unless partner funds defense.
- Data clause: require vendor to use KMS (customer-managed) for keys if storing customer PII; if not feasible, add encryption-at-rest + SOC2 attestation.
- Add fallback: if SLA breach > 3 occurrences in 6 months, automatic downgrade to support tier B + credit equal to 10% of monthly invoice.

HANDOFF NOTES FOR MIRA (if I OOO)
- Mira — look at Partner A redline draft in draft-GoogleDoc (linked in Jira-1428). Key ask: check IP indemnity language and whether we can accept 'defend and indemnify' as-is.
- Also check clause on audit rights — I want to limit vendor audit to 1x per year with 30-day notice.

CALENDAR / TIMING
- 2026-03-12 10:00 — quick sync with AP (Samir invited) to reconcile INV-0117.
- 2026-03-12 15:00 — draft redline review (15–20m) with Mira if available.
- Block 2026-03-13 09:00–10:30 for finalizing month-end payments and JP Morgan approvals.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs
- Who owns vendor onboarding checklist for Partner A? (I think Solutions Eng, need to confirm with Lina).
- VAT handling on EU invoices: confirm with tax counsel whether we should gross-up for the 20% VAT on ACME invoice (INV-0117) or treat as vendor responsibility.
- Confirm delegated signing threshold: is $25k still auto by Finance Lead or need CFO sign-off?

MICRO NOTES (for reference)
- If redline accepted, create playbook snippet for similar reseller agreements — standard clause text saved in Confluence under 'reseller-snippets'.
- Keep a short email template for late invoice vendors: subject = "Redwood: invoice INV-XXXX — follow-up & request for backup".

WILD IDEAS / FUTURE
- Could we add a small validation check in AP pipeline that flags credit mismatches automatically? Quick ask for infra: a webhook to GitHub Actions or simple serverless function to validate invoice line totals vs credits.

LAST-MINUTE REMINDERS
- Double-check AP screenshot timestamps before sending to vendor (we had one case where vendor screenshot was UTC vs PST, caused confusion).
- Save final redline PDF to contract repo + mark JIRA-1428 as ready-for-legal.

If I finish early: draft one-pager for execs summarizing month burn impact of delayed invoices (top 5 outstanding >30 days).

Notes-to-self: breathe. prioritize >$10k items, escalate if anything blocks payment run.

Revision history: quick personal log — 2026-02-27 initial draft; 2026-03-05 added Partner A redline; 2026-03-12 reconciled invoice details and updated calendar blocks.
